title: Instagram Introduces Story Editing Feature, Allowing Users to Make Changes After Posting
summary: Instagram introduces story editing feature allowing changes after posting
detailed: Meta has rolled out a new feature called “Edit Stories” on Instagram, enabling users to modify their published stories without having to delete and repost them.
Until now, users who spotted a mistake after publishing a story had no option to correct it and had to delete the entire story before posting it again.
With the new feature, users will be able to edit text, music, stickers and drawings in a story after it has been published.
Instagram head Adam Mosseri explained the update in a post, saying the feature would allow users to make changes to their stories even after publication.
sentences: Meta has rolled out a new feature called “Edit Stories” on Instagram, enabling users to modify their published stories without having to delete and repost them.
Instagram Stories is one of the platform’s most popular features.
Until now, users who spotted a mistake after publishing a story had no option to correct it and had to delete the entire story before posting it again.
With the new feature, users will be able to edit text, music, stickers and drawings in a story after it has been published.
Instagram head Adam Mosseri explained the update in a post, saying the feature would allow users to make changes to their stories even after publication.
To use the option, users need to tap the “More” button in the upper-right corner of their story and select “Edit Story”.
However, the editing facility will only remain available for 15 minutes after a story is posted.
Changes will not be possible once that time limit has passed.
Alongside Edit Stories, Instagram has introduced three additional features for Stories.
These include new sticker designs, background options for photos of any size, and an easier way to select multiple pictures.
The rollout of these features has begun, and they are expected to become available to all users over the next few weeks.
